name: Duplicate Processing

required_evidence.description: Evidence the two transactions are distinct (different items/dates) or that only one was ever settled

any_one_of.description: Any proof the charge was not duplicated

source_reference: Visa Core Rules ID#0004544, updated 2026-01. Note: CE3.0 (2-of-4 rule) applies to first-party misuse claims, not billing/processing errors — not applicable to 12.6.
